name: Customer inbox triage and reply drafter
why: Ranks new customer emails and drafts a checked reply for each, the same run as the triage skill.

name: Clear your support inbox and turn fixes into help pages
why: Clears open tickets and turns each fix into a help page, like the backlog prompt plus the weekly step.

name: Monthly returns and refunds reviewer
why: Finds the products driving refunds and the first fix to make, matching the monthly review workflow.

name: Returns policy designer
why: Sets refund timing, keep-it rules and a recovery budget from returns data, before the policy rewrite.

name: Angry customer reply writer
why: A reply that names the feeling and fixes what it can without false promises.

name: Apology email writer
why: A short apology that owns the mistake and states the fix, for the hard-case templates.

name: Monthly help centre keeper
why: Finds questions the help pages miss each month, in the spirit of capture-and-improve.

name: Help article writer from support tickets
why: Turns a group of tickets about one problem into a help article in the customer's words.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Builds an FAQ page from real customer questions and approved answers.

name: Public review reply desk
why: Checked replies to public reviews, with risky ones held for the owner.

name: Support bot error reviewer
why: Finds wrong bot answers against approved help text, so bots stay inside the policy.

name: Delivery update flow builder
why: Delivery updates and a delay script that cut 'where is my order' tickets before they arrive.
